work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Station utility power failure at ~18:04 during -8F cold snap. PLC/comms on UPS (limited duration), heat trace on instrument rack and sensing lines is on utility power and is now off -> risk of frozen sensing lines/false or blinded instrument readings and hydrates. Methanol pump power status unknown. Need on-site verification, restore power/generator, check heat trace & methanol.
